description: This file contains the source code for the 'Statistics' model class within the Opencart Admin Model Report namespace. It provides methods for retrieving and updating statistics data stored in the database, including getting all statistics, getting, adding, removing, and editing specific statistic values.

classes.name: Statistics
classes.description: Model class for handling statistics data, extending the engine's base Model class and providing methods for interacting with the 'statistics' table in the database.

methods.name: getStatistics
methods.description: Retrieves all statistics records from the database as an array.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Fetches the value associated with a specific statistic code.

methods.name: addValue
methods.description: Increments the statistic value for a given code.

methods.name: removeValue
methods.description: Decrements the statistic value for a given code.

methods.name: editValue
methods.description: Sets the statistic value for a specific code to a new value.
